---
title: "Artificial Intelligence I 2019-1"
---

This course introduces the foundations of machine learning and artificial intelligence, including supervised learning, feature extraction, linear regression, cross-validation, gradient descent optimization, and neural networks, with emphasis on practical implementation and data-driven modeling.     
ITM – Institución Universitaria @2019
